Coram : J.S. KHEHAR*, ARUN MISHRA
Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 1972: rr. 9(2)(b)(ii), 9(6)(a) - Withholding of gratuity pending C departmental proceedings - Held: r.9(2)(b)(ii) mandates that no departmental proceedings can be initiated after the retirement of an employee, unless a charge sheet has been issued within event of delinquency - r. 9(6)(a), by a deeming fiction of law mandates that departmental D proceedings will be deemed to have been initiated against an employee who has been placed under suspension - In the instant case, respondent was placed under suspension, for the first time, on 3. 12. 2007 -
Decision Date : 16-09-2014 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 8854/2014 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
